title: A geometric simplex method in infinite-dimensional spaces
summary: We expand the basic geometric elements of the simplex method to linear programs in locally convex topological vector spaces and provide conditions under which the method converges in value to optimality. This setting generalizes many previous investigations of the simplex method, which are restricted to Hilbert spaces or otherwise specially structured instances.
